title: ASCII Art Service State
description: Converts an image (Blob) into a text grid of ASCII characters representing its luminance. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/ascii-art)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

cols.description: Number of character columns in the output grid

rows.description: Number of character rows in the output grid

charset.description: Ordered character ramp from lightest to darkest

invert.description: When true, reverses the luminance mapping (dark → light characters)

imageKey.description: Key on the incoming object that holds the Blob
